decisions.why: Chondro Gide cartilage membrane and interference screws/tape sutures are knee ligament/cartilage reconstruction implants.
Interference screws, tape suture systems and Tenolig tendon repair devices are foot/ankle soft-tissue repair implants.
Fh Bio Anchors (suture anchors) and Arrow Shoulder Prosthesis are shoulder/upper limb implants.
Atlas Elastic Cup and Hipn Go dual mobility/press-fit cups are hip implant components.
